---
title: Vision & Multimodal
description: Process and analyze visual content with Peaking AI's multimodal capabilities.
---

import { Tabs, TabItem } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

Peaking AI models can process images alongside text, enabling visual question answering, document analysis, image description, and more.

## Supported models

Vision capabilities are available on **Peak-1** and **Peak-1 Pro**. Peak-1 Flash does not support image inputs.

## Sending images

Pass images as part of the message content using base64 encoding or URLs:

<Tabs>
  <TabItem label="URL">
  ```python
  response = client.chat.create(
      model="peak-1",
      messages=[{
          "role": "user",
          "content": [
              {"type": "text", "text": "What's in this image?"},
              {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "https://example.com/photo.jpg"}}
          ]
      }]
  )
  ```
  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Base64">
  ```python
  import base64

  with open("photo.jpg", "rb") as f:
      image_data = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode()

  response = client.chat.create(
      model="peak-1",
      messages=[{
          "role": "user",
          "content": [
              {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."},
              {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {
                  "url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{image_data}"
              }}
          ]
      }]
  )
  ```
  </TabItem>
</Tabs>

## Use cases

### Document analysis

Extract structured data from invoices, receipts, or forms:

```python
response = client.chat.create(
    model="peak-1-pro",
    messages=[{
        "role": "user",
        "content": [
            {"type": "text", "text": "Extract all line items, amounts, and the total from this invoice. Return as JSON."},
            {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": invoice_url}}
        ]
    }],
    response_format={"type": "json_object"}
)
```

### Visual Q&A

Ask questions about image content:

```python
response = client.chat.create(
    model="peak-1",
    messages=[{
        "role": "user",
        "content": [
            {"type": "text", "text": "How many people are in this photo? What are they doing?"},
            {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": photo_url}}
        ]
    }]
)
```

## Supported formats

| Format | Max size | Notes |
|--------|----------|-------|
| JPEG | 20 MB | Recommended for photos |
| PNG | 20 MB | Best for screenshots, diagrams |
| WebP | 20 MB | Good compression |
| GIF | 20 MB | First frame only |

:::note
Images are automatically resized if they exceed 2048px on the longest side. For best results with small text or fine details, use images under 2048px and choose Peak-1 Pro.
:::
